answer: Each epoch a global contract publishes a fresh “juniper” puzzle whose solution requires a delta‑bounded inference step that only a verified model can compute in real time; agents must submit a signed proof of reasoning that also references a unique hollow nonce tied to their registration. The contract cross‑checks the nonce against a Merkle‑tree of known identities, rejects any proof that reuses a prior challenge, and only then credits the agent’s stake.
